title: The Hot Pink Sequin Blazer NYE Office Party Outfit
description: A hot pink New Year's Eve office party outfit from Amazon: a pink sequin open front blazer, a black satin cami, black satin wide leg pants, gold slingback kitten heels, a gold glitter clutch and gold disco ball earrings.
intro: Every December the office party invite says "festive attire" and every December I panic in front of my closet. Not this year. A hot pink sequin blazer does all the work, black satin pants and a cami keep it grown up, and gold kitten heels mean I can stand by the snack table for three hours. Disco ball earrings because it's New Year's and I'm not apologizing. Bonus: the blazer goes straight from the party to brunch with jeans.

sections.heading: The outfit
paragraphs: The KANCY KOLE sequin open front blazer in pink over the Zeagoo black satin crewneck cami, with Facogoo black satin wide leg pants.

sections.heading: Shoes, bag and the sparkly bits
paragraphs: Elisabet Tang gold slingback kitten heel pumps (a 3 in heel), a gold glitter pleated clutch with a rhinestone ring (7 x 5 x 2 in) and Rave Envy gold disco ball earrings.

sections.heading: Shop it
paragraphs: Every piece is linked below, and every look I make lives on my Amazon storefront: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit
